title: Parenting Then and Now: What Changed and What Did Not?
description: Parenting has changed dramatically since the 1970s. But the goal has not: helping children become healthy, capable, secure adults. The difference is not that one generation “cared more.” Parents have responded to different social conditions, technologies, economic pressures, educational expectations, and scientific knowledge. A fair comparison requires understanding both the strengths and limitations of each era.
